about: Control (#10964): a true SQL-injection finding whose consequence quotes the attack payload, which is not in the file, survives on its placed quote.

findings.title: SQL injection
findings.body: `q = "SELECT pw FROM users WHERE name = '" + user` concatenates form input into SQL.
findings.consequence: An input such as `' OR '1'='1' --` logs in as any user.
findings.quoted_snippet: q = "SELECT pw FROM users WHERE name = '" + user
